subject: gk
question: What is the name of the flagship program that was launched in 2005 to address the lack of infrastructure in urban India?

options.text: Integrated Development of Small & Medium Towns
Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation
Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission

solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission (JnNURM):-**

 
 
• **It was a massive city-modernisation scheme launched by the Government of India under the Ministry of Urban Development in 2005.**
 
• It aimed to improve cities' infrastructure and governance by making various services available to all urban resident
